about: The communio of the formulary “Second Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: The Lord says: Fill the water jars with water and carry it to the chief steward of the feast. When the chief steward had tasted the water made into wine, he says to the bridegroom: You have kept the good wine until now. Jesus worked this sign first in the presence of His disciples.
